### Kintsukuroi
Author: Ryan Duncan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-june-6-2014.html
Passage: 1 Peter 5:10
Points:
- The Japanese craft of kintsukuroi mends fractured pottery with precious metal lacquer, making the piece more beautiful for having been broken.
- Human beings have been fractured and deformed by sin, yet God refuses to discard them.
- Rather than throwing away broken lives, God gathers the fragments and lovingly restores them through Christ.
- Reconstructed by divine grace, believers stand as living works of art that reflect God's glory.
- Personal restoration points ahead to the day when Christ will renew all of creation.

### Strengthened Through Suffering
Author: C. P. Hia
Site: Our Daily Bread
URL: https://military.odb.org/strengthened-through-suffering/
Passage: 1 Peter 5:10
Points:
- Common church benedictions draw on Peter's benediction but often overlook the uncomfortable reality of suffering.
- Believers who seek to live godly lives and resist evil should expect trials and misunderstandings.
- Hardships are not arbitrary; God uses difficulties purposefully to train and mature His people.
- The trials endured today fortify Christians to withstand future storms and live faithfully for God.
